title: Revert to Version 18

requirements.text: Revert the entire application (frontend and backend) to the state it was in at Version 18, undoing all changes introduced in Versions 19, 20, and 21.
acceptanceCriteria: The deployed application matches the exact state of Version 18.
All changes introduced after Version 18 (Versions 19, 20, 21) are fully reverted.
The application builds and deploys successfully from the Version 18 codebase.

constraints: Do not retain any changes from Versions 19, 20, or 21.
Restore the exact Version 18 state for both frontend and backend.
nonGoals: Fixing the permission/authorization error that was attempted in Versions 19–21.
Introducing any new features or modifications beyond the revert.
